main_text.head: Ad Gvlielmvm Lvrivm Longanum Senatorem Burdeg.

p.i: Cum mi talia reddit una, ad illum
Nec tuis precibus locúsve opúsve est:
At saltem mihi Diua carmen inquam,
Te nostri comitem chori esse dicas,
Hoc illi satis est, sacris Camœnis
Qui sic vnicè amat, colit, foueíque, vt

page.notes: The first stanza is set in italic; the initial O is a large woodcut-style letter. Catchword "Pro-" printed at lower right. Some words in the verse are blurred; readings such as "locúsve opúsve" and "Ecquid tum" are doubtful.
